# @stapel/docs-react 0.2.0

Headless React flow pair for stapel-docs (contract >=0.1 <0.2) — business + state, zero
visual opinion in the main entry; the opt-in `/default` subpath ships the self-themed antd
skin (FileManager + context menus, RevisionsModal, DocSurface + default editors), every
part swappable via registerDocsSkinComponent / registerDocEditor.
Built on @stapel/core: typed client + StapelApiError envelope, auth token refresh,
verification-403 interception, i18n engine, analytics facade, TanStack Query layer.

HAND-AUTHORED SLICE: stapel-docs has not committed its contract artifacts yet, so
this file (and the pair's api types) are typed to the module's endpoint table and
will be regenerated by the gen:* drivers once the backend contract lands.

## The one right way (do this, the rest is a review/lint smell)
- No raw fetch/axios. The client is injected via <DocsProvider>/StapelConfigProvider;
  every hook already carries auth and the error envelope.
- Server state = the use* hooks (query layer); keys come only from docsQueryKeys.
- User strings = i18n keys (registerDocsI18n); never string literals.
- New document type? REGISTER an editor — registerDocEditor(hint, component) —
  never fork the pair. Resolution: explicit registration > builtin > null
  (null = download-only; render MediaViewer).
- Content saves are snapshots with If-Match: the DocEditor bag owns head_seq,
  conflict state (409/412 → typed {headSeq, savedBy, savedAt}, NOT an exception),
  and overrideSave() (re-reads the head; the override lands as a new revision).

## Layers
api (typed client + raw content ops) · model (hooks, keys) · editors (registry +
builtins text/markdown/csv) · headless (render-prop bags) · i18n

## Operations (typed; use the named op, never a path string)
Paths are relative to `/docs/api/v1/`. Full catalog: manifest.json §operations.
- folders: list?workspace_id · create · get/patch/delete /folders/:id · POST /folders/:id/restore
- documents: list?workspace_id&folder_id&type&q · create · get/patch/delete /documents/:id · POST .../restore
- content: GET .../content (raw bytes; X-Docs-Head-Seq/ETag carry head_seq) ·
  PUT .../content + If-Match → 200 {head_seq, revision_id} | 409 {head_seq, saved_by, saved_at} | 412
- GET .../download → {url} (opaque) · GET .../export?format=pdf → binary
- updates: GET .../updates?since= · POST .../updates (crdt types only; v1 builtins are all snapshot)
- revisions: list · POST {name} · GET :rid/content · GET :rid/download · POST :rid/restore
- trash: GET /trash?workspace_id → {folders, documents} · POST /trash/empty {workspace_id, ids?} (ids may name folders and documents)
- uploads: POST /uploads → {upload_id, document_id, key, put_url} · POST /uploads/:id/finalize
  (local-storage backend profile: put_url is NOT writable — use PUT .../content; useUpload exposes both via "put_url" | "content")

## Query hooks (docsQueryKeys — never string keys)
- useFolders / useFolderTree (one cache entry, tree via select) — ["docs","folders",ws]
- useDocuments(params) — ["docs","documents",params]
- useDocument / useDocumentContent (text decode + headSeq) / useRevisions /
  useRevisionContent (revision preview text) / useDownloadUrl — per-document keys
- useTrash(ws) — ["docs","trash",ws] → {folders, documents}
- mutations: useSaveContent (If-Match; conflict = data), useCreateRevision,
  useRestoreRevision, useTrashActions, useUpload (both delivery paths), useExportUrl,
  useCreateFolder/useUpdateFolder/useTrashFolder, useCreateDocument/useUpdateDocument/
  useTrashDocument (rename + move are the SAME patch — no separate move endpoint)

## Headless bags (render-prop, bring your own UI)
DocumentList · FolderTree · Breadcrumbs · DocEditor (value/setValue/save/dirty/
conflict/overrideSave) · RevisionHistory · TrashBin ({folders, documents}) ·
DocUploader · MediaViewer (kind by MIME prefix image/|video/ else "download").
List/tree/trash/revision READS are LoadState fields (core loadStateFromQuery;
render with matchList/matchLoad — the absence of a result is not a result;
stapel/no-flattened-load-state). Write errors ride separate fields.

## /default — the opt-in skin subpath (antd stays out of the main bundle)
- FileManager (tree + list + breadcrumbs + trash view; context menus wired 1:1 to the
  server: rename/move = PATCH, trash = DELETE, restore, download, version history —
  NO duplicate item, stapel-docs has no duplicate endpoint) · RevisionsModal (list +
  preview + rollback-as-new-head) · DocSurface (ladder: registerDocEditor explicit >
  skin editor slot > builtin > FileCard) · DefaultText/Markdown(source)/Csv editors ·
  FileCard (image/video/download).
- SELF-THEMED: every surface wraps DocsSkinTheme (@stapel/tokens → toAntdThemeConfig;
  mode from the host document's data-theme, `mode` prop pins a side).
- SWAPPABLE: registerDocsSkinComponent("fileManager.treePane" | "fileManager.listPane" |
  "fileManager.breadcrumbs" | "fileManager.trashPane" | "revisionsModal" | "fileCard" |
  "editor.text" | "editor.markdown" | "editor.csv", Component) — resolution explicit >
  builtin, same seam shape as the editor registry.

## Errors (render t(code, params))
stapel-docs has no committed error registry yet — DOCS_ERRORS is empty, core's
stapel.http.<status> fallback + docs.error.unknown cover the gap.

## Snippets
```tsx
// Resolve the editor for a document — the registry is the seam, not a fork.
const Editor = resolveDocEditor(doc.editor_hint);
return Editor ? (
  <DocEditor documentId={doc.id}>{(bag) => <Editor bag={bag} />}</DocEditor>
) : (
  <MediaViewer documentId={doc.id}>{({ url }) => <a href={url ?? "#"}>{t(DOCS_I18N_KEYS.mediaDownload)}</a>}</MediaViewer>
);
```
```tsx
// Conflict is typed state: render it, offer the override.
{bag.conflict && (
  <div role="alert">
    {t(DOCS_I18N_KEYS.editorConflict)}
    <button onClick={bag.overrideSave}>{t(DOCS_I18N_KEYS.editorOverride)}</button>
  </div>
)}
```
